lithos_version: lithos 0.5.0 @ a4d2d62; return shapes cross-checked against the live tools/list surface (MCP serverInfo 3.2.0, 2026-10-04)

request.notes: The whole request surface: a terminal (completed/cancelled) task back to `open`. Clears `resolved_at` and `outcome`, records the reopen as a `[Reopened]` finding (the only surviving evidence of the prior outcome — see tasks.REOPENED_FINDING_PREFIX) and emits `task.reopened`. An already-open task is `task_not_resolved`, a missing one `task_not_found`. `task_id` accepts a full id OR an unambiguous >= 6-character prefix; Lens always sends a full id (the funnel acts on a task it has just read), so the prefix path and its `ambiguous_id_prefix` refusal are not on any Lens request for this tool.

observed_divergences: `reblocked` is a list of task IDS, not records, and it is non-empty ONLY when a *completed* blocker or gate is reopened: reopening a CANCELLED task un-strands its dependents (they were `blocker_unsatisfiable`, not ready) and so re-blocks nobody — the `cancelled_reopen` variant above. That is why T3 D8 counts the cancelled case from the task's own active outgoing dependency edges instead. The payload also carries the resolved `task_id`/`title` and the new `updated_at` beside the quoted `{"success", "reblocked"}`. The id resolves from a >= 6-char prefix, so a caller that sent one could see `ambiguous_id_prefix` — Lens never sends one, so it is not listed above.
